title: Book Two · Chapter 66: The Last Cold Morning
story:
The cold months come and go. Ronan stays nine through the short winter holiday. School begins again. Now the mornings grow warmer, and a long spring holiday is close.

On the last cold morning, he pulls his sleeves over his hands. The blue bike stands against the yard wall. Dad checks the brake before he leaves for work.

“Can we take it out in the holiday?” Ronan asks.

“On my free afternoon, if the square is clear.”

“Can we go farther?”

“We can look at the way together.”

Ronan turns the old bell. It does not move on the handlebar. Dad tightens nothing today. He puts his tools away and takes his bag.

Inside, Mum has three collection times on a paper. Two customers want their clothes before the holiday. She has a visit of her own on the second day.

“Can we all go out on the first day?” Ronan asks.

“I work that morning,” she says.

“But school is closed.”

“My customers still have clothes.”

Ronan looks at the paper. One collection is before lunch. The other is after. He wants a family outing between those times. But there is almost no time for it.

Mum sees his finger move down the page.

“Ask Dad about his afternoon. I can join you after the last collection.”

“Only if it is early?”

“Yes. Do not wait all day at the door for me.”

At school, Jun plans to visit a relative during the break. Mei wants to draw the tree near her home. Leo has two reading mornings. But he has a break from one other activity.

“We can play on that day,” Leo says.

“Outside the reading room?”

“Here. With a ball.”

Ronan agrees quickly. Then he remembers Mum's collection day. They compare their plans and choose another afternoon.

Miss Wu gives the class a short holiday page. They can read it at home and bring it back. There is no prize if a child finishes first.

Ronan puts it inside his folder. At the doorway, the wind pulls one sleeve away from his hand. The air feels warmer now.

At home, he finds Dad's free afternoon on the calendar. Mum marks the time for her last collection. Ronan draws a tiny wheel below both marks. At first the wheel is very round. Then his pencil slips.

Dad looks at it that evening.

“A good wheel,” he says. “But we may need to mend that corner.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cold＝冷的；sleeve＝袖子；holiday＝假期。

## 理解问题

1. 时间怎样变化了？
2. Mum为什么不能在放假第一天外出？

## 读句子

**Ronan / puts it / inside his folder.** Ronan／把它放进／自己的文件夹。
